summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing opaque bun payload
details: The package declares an obfuscated `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB compiled/obfuscated bun-cjs blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotated string arrays, hex-named symbols) with no corresponding source in the package tree and no reference from the declared plugin sources (`src/index.ts`, `src/cli.ts`, `src/secrets.ts`). The declared purpose is a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin, which has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque compiled payload at install time. The package.json `repository.url` points at `https://github.com/servicetitan/uikit.git`, positioning the package as a ServiceTitan-authored Verdaccio plugin — consistent with dependency-confusion/impersonation. The preinstall setup script itself is obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifier mangling and string-map indirection, hiding the dropper logic from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
